data.name: Greater Mesmerizing Feint
data.description: You can feint against nearly any creature. You can feint against mindless creatures at a -4 penalty. Such a creature must be a subject of your hypnotic stare, and the creature has a 50% chance of ignoring the effects of your feint.
prerequisites: PREABILITY:2,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Mesmerist ~ Hypnotic Stare,Bold Stare ~ Psychic Inception
